annotations.title: News headlines, latest news: search current news articles (Brave)

description: Search current news and get the latest headlines as JSON: title, URL, snippet, publisher domain and age, from the Brave Search API's news index. 1-20 results per call; freshness limits results to the past day, week or month. Results are for the caller's immediate use only: no storing, resale or model training (Brave API terms). Upstream failures and exhausted capacity return 503, uncharged. Use when an agent needs current news on a topic. Example: q=bitcoin ETF. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits); failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

freshness.description: Only articles from the past day, week or month (default: any age)

q.description: News search query, at most 400 characters
